source.label: Paired source recursion and goal-level review

reviewer: Codex with one isolated medium reviewer

claims.summary: For every m>=2 in characteristic!=2, the original n=2m+1 bulk d>=2m-1 has full paired source direct_sum_epsilon p_epsilon F_c, c=2^m(d-m+1)-1, p_epsilon=w_epsilon*g_epsilon, every g_epsilon of degree2^m-m-1 with explicit binary exponents. The actual common unit has ratio G_m=product ell_i^(2^(i-1)) between adjacent degrees. For n=2m+2,d>=2m, the full source is direct_sum p_epsilon(F_c+v G_m F_(c-2^m)). Exact full cut codimensions are4^m-(3m+5)2^(m-2) and3*4^m-3(m+2)2^(m-1), respectively. The actual pre-merge four-block family is retained. Invertibility of the full square marked restriction is equivalent to paired normality and sufficient for original normality; universal invertibility is not claimed.
claims.assessment: Working uniform source reduction. Induction uses the same normalization on even and odd new-character blocks, complete balanced polynomial division, independent limiting characters and exact original dimensions. Remainders plus all omitted top coefficients give surjective cut maps. Riemann–Roch proves the marked domains have exactly the cut dimensions, not that the restrictions are invertible.126 character/divisor controls through six pairs, both endpoint counts and the full previous three-pair table pass.
claims.rationale: Makes the existing finite-dimensional paired-source mechanism explicit for any number of pairs, preserving the actual deformation and its coupling. This is a refinement of the recorded source proofs and general division method, not a new normality principle or independent novelty claim.

conj:cube-refined-initial-segment-law.assessment: Conjecture in the remaining n>=9 small-prime range outside established subranges. Proved in characteristic zero for all n,d; in every characteristic not2 for n<=8 and d>=2; for p>2^(n-1)d; and in the recorded periodic bands. Degree-one orders retain the Catalan law. The all-pair source recursion is a reduction, not a normality proof. Generic normality does not determine pre-stable thresholds.
